findings.criterion: accessibility.md rule 1; WCAG 2.5.8 and MS-10.4 inline exception applies
findings.evidence: Inline link in a sentence, 187x22px at 1280x800 (203x48px at 320 wide).
findings.fix: Optional: move it into a .site-links row (a copy and layout decision).

findings.criterion: Forced-colors good practice (no WCAG 2.2 AA failure; drawings are aria-hidden)
findings.where: .nl-key in KeypadDemo, KeypadPicture and the section drawings
findings.evidence: With forced-colors: active the keys lose fill and have no edge; the keypad picture reads as loose letters. Screenshot docs/a11y/screens/ml2-desk-1280x800-forced-colors.png.
findings.fix: In components.css add @media (forced-colors: active) { .nl-key { border: var(--line-width) solid transparent; } } and re-check /app.

findings.criterion: WCAG 2.1.1 / 2.4.3 pass; usability. MS-6.7 requires Hear it disabled while the demo plays
findings.evidence: With motion on, Tab had 34 stops instead of 35 at 1280x800 and 1133x658: 'Hear it' is disabled during the ~6 s automatic play, so Tab skips it.
findings.fix: Optional: use aria-disabled="true" and ignore presses while playing, so it stays focusable; confirm with the spec owner first.

resolvedSincePreviousAudit: FAQ summaries now 10px apart (was 2px; MS-10.4), measured at 14 configurations.
Focus rings no longer clipped at the viewport bottom: 0px clipped over 184 Tab stops in 6 configurations.
Primary buttons keep a 2px border in forced colors.
